reviews.author: Darlene Riccardi
reviews.text: Danny came to tow our car, we had an agreed upon price. He was clean, friendly, cheerful… While I was in the house, evidently he looked under the car. I came out and was told it was the skidplate that was hanging under the car. Danny said to me, “I tied it up there so you don’t need the tow, just bring it to the shop”. Wait, what?!? You drove all the way here to tow me, and you do that, losing the tow?! Then he said, “Here, I found this clip on the ground, likely what was holding it up.” This man is so honest, and helpful! I am just floored! Tossed him a few bucks- against his will- to get some breakfast. He deserved at least that. I would 100% recommend his business. Saved me some money, which I am so grateful for, and reminded me why I love small town friendly so much. Thank you Danny.

reviews.author: Casey Cooper
reviews.text: Extremely fast and super nice. If you ever need help call him. If he is available he will come right to you. Saved me and my husband today. So grateful

reviews.author: Fred Mead
reviews.text: Friendly help with my truck gave me the advise I needed . I'm getting my sniper fuel injection setup factory repaired at no cost to me thanks Danny. Small Town friendly!

reviews.author: Susan Stiver
reviews.text: I've used Danny's towing service five times that I can think off. They are always prompt, friendly and fairly priced; in a word professional! I always feel well taken care of and that I've gotten a good deal from their service.

reviews.author: Barbara Pinkston
reviews.text: They are the nicest people. My SUV could not be fixed. He checked everything possible. Kept in contact with me over it. I decided to voluntarily surrender it back to the finance company. Too much was wrong. He allowed me to come clean it out & He also towed it there for me. He had also towed it from the mechanic shop I originally had it at. All together my bill was less than $200
